tools.name: registries_fdic-bank-lookup
tools.description: Find a US FDIC-insured or formerly insured institution by certificate number, RSSD id, or name in the vendored FDIC BankFind institutions file before you pay or onboard a registered institution. Returns status, charter class, and end date; ambiguous names return candidates. Call with optional cert,

tools.name: registries_ncua-credit-union-lookup
tools.description: Find a US credit union by NCUA charter number, RSSD id, name, or trade name from the vendored NCUA 5300 Call Report FOICU and TradeNames files before you pay or onboard a registered institution. Only credit unions that filed in that cycle are listed. Call with optional charter, rssd, name, state, li

tools.name: registries_uk-charity-lookup
tools.description: Find a charity on the Charity Commission register for England and Wales by registered number or name from a vendored charity-level subset of the register extract before you pay or onboard a registered institution. Removed charities are reported, not missed. Call with optional charityNumber, name, in
